title: How to plan your SHRM HR-X Live! 2027 trip to Chicago
summary: Plan your SHRM HR-X Live! 2027 trip to Chicago with guidance on the hotel block, airports, transit, budget, agenda, dining, and packing.
body_markdown:
SHRM HR-X Live! 2027 takes place June 27–30 at McCormick Place in Chicago. It replaces SHRM’s Annual Conference & Expo with a four-day experience focused on applied learning and a credential.\[1\]\[2\]


If you are planning to attend, this is a comprehensive guide to help build a trip around your specific HR problem that you want to focus on and the learning pathway you choose. We’ll also cover travel logistics, and help ensure your trip leaves time for meals, colleague discussions, and travel between commitments.


### Key takeaways


- The official hotel block deadline is June 1, 2027. Shuttles will serve select event hotels; confirm participation and service hours before booking.\[3\]
- Midway is closer to McCormick Place than O’Hare, but compare flight options, traffic, and the route to your hotel before choosing.\[3\]
- CTA buses and the Green Line serve the venue, and a Metra Electric station is inside the South Building.\[5\]
- Chicago’s June 2027 federal rates are around $240 per night for lodging before taxes and $92 for a full day of meals and incidental expenses. Your employer’s limits may differ.\[6\]


## What is SHRM HR-X Live! and who is it for?


SHRM HR-X Live! is SHRM’s flagship event for HR professionals. The 2027 program follows its HR Excellence framework across four dimensions: Talent Optimization, Organizational Impact, Functional Acceleration, and Market Discernment.\[1\]\[2\]


Before arriving, attendees answer questions about their work. SHRM recommends a dimension and level, and you can keep that recommendation or choose another pathway.\[2\] It’s advisable to review the pathway, credential requirements, and registration inclusions before committing to the trip.


## What makes SHRM HR-X Live! 2027 worth the trip?


SHRM describes a program with applied exercises and a capstone opportunity to demonstrate what you have learned.\[2\] To make that work relevant, bring one workplace challenge, the constraints around it, and the questions you need to answer. If your employer is funding the trip, agree in advance on what you will bring back, such as a proposed change to an HR process or a plan for testing an idea.


If colleagues are attending, compare pathway choices before registration. You can work on different questions and use a daily debrief to connect what each person learns.


## Where to stay for SHRM HR-X Live! 2027


McCormick Place is at 2301 S. Martin Luther King Drive, Chicago, IL 60616. SHRM’s official hotel page links to the event block, quotes a June 1, 2027 housing deadline, and confirms shuttles from select hotels.\[3\]


Start with the block, comparing the total price, room type, cancellation terms, and shuttle schedule. SHRM identifies MCI USA as its only housing provider and warns about fraudulent or unconfirmed offers from other companies.\[3\]\[4\] Verify unsolicited offers with the event team before sharing payment details.


### Hotel options according to priority


Where to look


Why it may fit

Official SHRM hotel block


Select event hotels offer shuttle service.\[3\]


Confirm the hotel’s pickup point, first and last shuttle times, total room price, cancellation terms, and booking cutoff.


Near McCormick Place


A short commute may help if you need to return to your room between activities.


Check the walking route to your assigned building, nearby dining, and any shuttle service.


South Loop or downtown


These areas may suit evening plans; CTA, Metra, and rideshare serve the venue.\[5\]\[7\]


Compare the commute at your actual travel times, late service, and daily transport costs.


A hotel outside the block may suit your budget or loyalty preferences. Compare the route from the property to your event entrance, rather than neighborhood alone. Check live rates and cancellation conditions before booking.

## How to budget for SHRM HR-X Live!


When aiming to build a complete budget, include registration, airfare, lodging, taxes, hotel fees, airport transfers, local transport, and meals in your estimate. It’s a good idea to check your employer’s booking channels and reimbursement limits before reserving anything.


### Federal per diem for Chicago in June 2027


The General Services Administration lists these FY 2027 rates for Chicago in June:\[6\]


- **Lodging:** The rate is $238 per night, excluding taxes.
- **Meals and incidental expenses (M&IE):** The full-day allowance is $92, comprising $23 for breakfast, $26 for lunch, $38 for dinner, and $5 for incidentals.
- **First and last travel days:** The M&IE allowance is $69, or 75% of the full-day amount.


These are federal reimbursement rates. Your company may set different limits, and federal travelers may need to deduct meals paid for by the government, such as through a conference registration fee.\[6\]


### Other costs to include


- **Hotel charges:** Compare taxes, facility fees, and any premium for a refundable rate.
- **Transport:** Price both airport transfers and each daily shuttle, CTA, Metra, taxi, or rideshare trip.
- **Meals and activities:** Allow for meals outside registration, group dinners, and optional evening plans.
- **Flight extras:** Include checked baggage and airport meals, and leave time for transit delays.


## Plan your SHRM HR-X Live! agenda


Use your registration and event materials to confirm the current pathway, session schedule, and credential requirements.\[2\] Here is a good rule of thumb to follow:


- **Confirm your pathway:** Review the recommended dimension and any selection deadline in your registration materials.
- **Add the location:** Record the building, room, entrance, and check-in instructions. McCormick Place has multiple buildings.\[3\]\[5\]
- **Plan the first arrival:** Check the hotel shuttle or CTA/Metra schedule and allow time to walk inside the venue.
- **Leave space between activities:** Add program sessions and team meetings first, then allow time for meals, movement, networking and notes.
- **Coordinate with colleagues:** Share hotel and arrival plans, and confirm individual registration details and accessibility needs with SHRM.


Use this[conference-trip booking guide](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-book-a-conference-trip) to coordinate flights, hotels, and dinner around your schedule.


## What to pack for SHRM HR-X Live! 2027


The National Weather Service’s 1991–2020 June climate for Chicago shows an average high of about 80°F and low of about 61°F, with rain possible.\[8\] Check the forecast before packing, and choose clothing that follows any event guidance and suits your role and comfort. Here’s a general checklist:


- **Shoes and layers:** Pack comfortable walking shoes and a light layer for indoor rooms and evenings.
- **Rain protection:** Bring a compact umbrella or waterproof layer.
- **Phone essentials:** Pack a charger and portable battery, and save your registration details and any event app instructions.
- **Learning materials:** Bring notes for your pathway and planned team discussions.
- **Personal needs:** Carry medication, accessibility aids, and anything else you need for a full day away from your hotel.


## Getting from Chicago airports to McCormick Place


SHRM lists Midway (MDW) at about 8.7 miles and 20 minutes from McCormick Place, and O’Hare (ORD) at about 19.4 miles and 45 minutes.\[3\] These are approximate driving estimates; traffic, weather, and time of day can of course effect the journey.


- From O’Hare, take the CTA Blue Line and transfer to the Green Line in the Loop
- From Midway, take the Orange Line to Roosevelt
- Then the Green Line to Cermak-McCormick Place
- The Metra Electric station is inside the venue’s South Building.\[5\]


What to expect


Best fit


Official hotel shuttle


Shuttles serve select event hotels.\[3\]


Use it if your hotel participates and the service hours fit your program. Confirm the pickup point.


CTA


Airport routes require transfers to the Green Line; buses also serve the venue.\[5\]


Consider it if you can manage transfers and luggage. Check the route to your hotel as well.


Metra Electric


The South Building station connects with downtown Chicago.\[5\]


Compare it if your hotel route aligns with the service. Check departure times and station access.


Taxi or rideshare


These provide a direct ride, with travel time dependent on traffic.\[3\]\[5\]


Consider them for heavier luggage or when transit schedules do not fit.


Tip: Check CTA and Metra service alerts, schedules, and fares on your specific travel day, and confirm the entrance closest to your program.\[5\]


## Additional programming and evening plans


McCormick Place’s neighborhood guide lists nearby dining and attractions.\[9\] For plans in the Loop or another neighborhood, allow time for the outbound and return journeys before adding another commitment.


## How to network without losing focus


SHRM groups participants by dimension and level, with opportunities to connect beyond their pathway.\[2\] Bring a specific question you want to discuss or a practice you want to compare. Ask about the organization and constraints behind a colleague’s advice so you can judge whether it applies to your team.


Keep brief notes on useful ideas, agreed follow-ups, and next steps. Review them each evening, and use a short coworker debrief to decide which ideas deserve a closer look when you return. Jotting down specific takeaways to mention in any follow up correspondence will be far more effective than a general connection request.


## What to eat near SHRM HR-X Live! 2027


Ask Navan Edge to find restaurants near McCormick Place or your hotel based on your group size, budget, dietary needs, and preferred time. You can compare options and confirm a standard table reservation in the same chat as your flights and hotel. Here are three options for different event types:


- **Large team dinner:**[Gino’s East South Loop](https://www.ginoseast.com/events-south-loop/) **.** The South Loop location offers deep-dish pizza, group event packages, and full restaurant buyouts. Consider it for a casual group meal, and confirm the guest count, menu, and total cost before booking.\[11\]
- **Client or executive dinner:**[The Chicago Firehouse Restaurant](https://www.chicagofirehouse.com/) **.** This South Loop restaurant serves steaks, chops, and seafood and offers private dining rooms. Consider it for a business discussion that needs a dedicated space, and ask which room fits your group size.
- **Small team or partner dinner:**[Apolonia](https://www.apoloniachicago.com/) **.** At 105 East Cermak Road, Apolonia serves contemporary Mediterranean dishes. It’s an option for a smaller group that prefers a seasonal restaurant menu; check the current menu and availability for your party.


Arrange private dining or a restaurant buyout directly with the venue, and confirm capacity, minimum spend, dietary needs, accessibility, and cancellation terms. Allow time to get there from your last session.


## Make your SHRM HR-X Live! 2027 trip count


Choose a pathway that addresses a real HR question, book a hotel with a comfortable commute, and leave space to discuss what you learn. A clear plan for applying the ideas at work gives the trip value that extends far beyond the conference sessions.
